name: DMGPAL_0123_NORMAL
desc: Game Boy palette byte (bits 1-0 = shade of colour 0 ... bits 7-6 = colour 3): colours 0-3 shown as shades 0-3 (white, light grey, dark grey, black): the normal palette

name: DMGPAL_0000_WHITE
desc: Game Boy palette byte (bits 1-0 = shade of colour 0 ... bits 7-6 = colour 3): every colour white (blank screen, start of a fade in)

name: DMGPAL_3333_BLACK
desc: Game Boy palette byte (bits 1-0 = shade of colour 0 ... bits 7-6 = colour 3): every colour black (end of a fade to black)

name: DMGPAL_3210_INVERTED
desc: Game Boy palette byte (bits 1-0 = shade of colour 0 ... bits 7-6 = colour 3): shades reversed: the negative (hot-spot effect 03, keyboard blink)

name: DMGPAL_1233_DARKER1
desc: Game Boy palette byte (bits 1-0 = shade of colour 0 ... bits 7-6 = colour 3): one step darker than normal (title fade to black, step 1)

name: DMGPAL_2333_DARKER2
desc: Game Boy palette byte (bits 1-0 = shade of colour 0 ... bits 7-6 = colour 3): two steps darker than normal (title fade to black, step 2)

name: DMGPAL_0012_LIGHTER1
desc: Game Boy palette byte (bits 1-0 = shade of colour 0 ... bits 7-6 = colour 3): one step lighter than normal

name: DMGPAL_0001_LIGHTER2
desc: Game Boy palette byte (bits 1-0 = shade of colour 0 ... bits 7-6 = colour 3): two steps lighter than normal

name: DMGPAL_1023
desc: Game Boy palette byte (bits 1-0 = shade of colour 0 ... bits 7-6 = colour 3): colours 0 and 1 swapped

name: DMGPAL_2103
desc: Game Boy palette byte (bits 1-0 = shade of colour 0 ... bits 7-6 = colour 3): colour 0 dark grey, 1 light grey, 2 white, 3 black (sprite palette OBP1)

name: DMGPAL_2013
desc: Game Boy palette byte (bits 1-0 = shade of colour 0 ... bits 7-6 = colour 3): colour 0 dark grey, 1 white, 2 light grey, 3 black (sprite palette OBP1)
